An introduction to the Harappan civilisation in Delhi, then a day at Rakhigarhi, one of its largest cities.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Delhi
  • Rakhigarhi

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Delhi

    A short introduction to Harappan archaeology, and a museum gallery if it is open.

  2. Day 2: Rakhigarhi

    An early start for the archaeological landscape, lunch and the village today. Return to Delhi, or stay the night.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Explain the basics of Harappan archaeology before visiting a Harappan site.
  • Describe the archaeological landscape of Rakhigarhi, one of the largest Harappan cities.
  • Relate the ancient landscape at Rakhigarhi to the village that stands there today.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.

Programmes in this journey

  • Rakhigarhi: a Harappan city and a living village
  • A Delhi museum of your choice, with an archaeologist
  • The first cities: the Indus and its contemporaries
